newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa said to price convertible notes today.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa said to price convertible notes today.

text.p: The price for Alto Hornos de Mexico SA's $85 million senior discount convertible notes will be fixed on Tuesday, a source said.

Mexico's biggest steel firm, Ahmsa, said last week the company had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with its planned offering of Senior Discount Convertible Notes due 2001.
"The pricing will take place today on the Ahmsa convertible bond," said the source, who declined to be identified.
The notes are to be offered primarily in the United States and will be convertible into American Depositary Shares with each ADS representing five shares of the firm's common stock.
Ahmsa said it would use the proceeds to pay off short-term debt.
Lead manager is Merrill Lynch and Inverlat International Inc as co-manager, Ahmsa said.
